findings.evidence: Statement bullets assert Zod validation on both endpoints ('validating `title`, `year`, `month`, and `currency` with Zod' for POST /api/plans; 'after Zod field-level validation' for POST /api/plans/{planId}/items), but AC1-AC6 only describe the success/happy path for each endpoint; none of the six acceptance criteria specifies the expected behavior (e.g. rejection, error response) when submitted fields fail that Zod validation.
findings.message: The document's Statement promises Zod validation on both POST /api/plans and POST /api/plans/{planId}/items, but the Acceptance Criteria section has no criterion covering the invalid-input/validation-failure path for either endpoint - this promised behavior is silently absent from Acceptance Criteria.
